title: The Faithful Orchard
author: Marguerite Nystrom
blurb: Kestrel Yarrow, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
